d: A US federal jury has convicted Chinese technology giant Huawei Technologies on 10 criminal counts, including trade secret theft, bank fraud and conspiracy to defraud the United States. The verdict follows a four-day deliberation in Brooklyn, New York, while Huawei was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy and obstruction of justice. US prosecutors accused the company of stealing intellectual property from American telecom firms and concealing its business dealings in Iran.
